_comment: Template for .tune-up/config.json. Every key is optional; delete the _comment* keys and what you do not use. Scalars here override the default; lists ADD to the default. Keys that loosen a guard only take effect after: sh "<plugin>/scripts/py" scripts/guarda.py confiar <this file>.
_comment_language: Project language for replies and documents (en, pt-BR...). Overrides the user language. Empty = use the user's.
_comment_plans_dir: Folder of phase plans, relative to the git toplevel.
_comment_main_branches: Main branches. Direct commit and force push to them are blocked.
_comment_merge: false = Claude never runs gh pr merge; the merge is the owner's.
_comment_commit: false = committing while on a main branch is blocked. Branch from origin first.
_comment_synced: Folders kept in sync by a file-sync tool: the hook makes files writable before writing to them (chmod u+w on macOS/Linux, read-only attribute on Windows).
_comment_free_repos: Repos where the git guard rules are relaxed. Default: none.
_comment_research_paths: Paths that may be edited even in research mode.
_comment_phrases: Optional regexes (lowercase, no accents) that ADD to the built-in phrases: auth_phrases authorize a guarded action; research_on_phrases / research_off_phrases switch research mode.
_comment_bash_rules: Extra rules on the Bash command (regex, heredoc body excluded). action: block, ask or warn. msg: 1-2 sentences naming the right alternative.

bash_rules.msg: Explain the risk and what to do instead.

_comment_supabase_guard: true = writes to a hosted database need the owner's request in the turn. Turning it off only works in a trusted project.
_comment_line_limit: Max lines per code file (new files above it are denied). Raising it only works in a trusted project.
_comment_line_limit_exclude: Extra globs exempt from the line limit, e.g. generated code.
